#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

#define FOR(i,l,r) for(int i = (l);i < (r);i++)
#define ALL(x) (x).begin(),(x).end()
template<typename T> bool chmax(T& a,const T& b){return a < b ? (a = b,true) : false;}
template<typename T> bool chmin(T& a,const T& b){return b < a ? (a = b,true) : false;}
typedef long long ll;

ll K,P;
bool used [1000000];
const ll MOD = 1e9 + 7;

void dfs(ll curr)
{
	if(used [curr]) return;
	used [curr] = true;
	dfs(curr * K % P);
}

int main()
{
	scanf("%lld%lld",&P,&K);
	ll ans = 1;
	if(K == 1){
		(ans *= P) %= MOD;
	}
	for(ll i = 1;i < P;i++) if(used [i] == false){
		dfs(i);
		(ans *= P) %= MOD;
	}

	printf("%lld\n",ans);

	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
